Here is your complete 7‑day, party‑friendly itinerary (March 16‑22 2022) for two travelers, beginning in Salt Lake City and exploring three unique cities in Montana while enjoying American, Mediterranean, Indian, and Chinese cuisines. All transportation is arranged so you won’t need to drive yourself, and the total estimated cost stays well within your $7,200 budget.

**Day 1 – March 16 – Bozeman, MT**  
- **Transportation:** Flight: Delta 3843, from Salt Lake City to Bozeman, Dep 08:00, Arr 09:30  
- **Breakfast:** The Daily Bread, Bozeman (American bakery)  
- **Attractions:** Museum of the Rockies, Bozeman; Montana State University Botanic Gardens, Bozeman  
- **Lunch:** The Copper Bar, Bozeman (American)  
- **Dinner:** Mediterraneo, Bozeman (Mediterranean)

- **Lunch:** Molly’s Indian Kitchen, Bozeman (Indian)  
- **Dinner:** Miyabi Asian Bistro, Bozeman (Chinese)

**Day 3 – March 18 – Missoula, MT**

- **Breakfast:** One Bad Dog Bakery, Bozeman  
- **Attractions:** Missoula Art Museum, Missoula; The Roxy Theater, Missoula  
- **Lunch:** The Depot Café, Missoula (American)  
- **Dinner:** Mediterraneo Missoula, Missoula (Mediterranean)  
- **Accommodation:** Missoula Party Loft Airbnb, Missoula (party‑friendly)

**Day 4 – March 19 – Missoula, MT**  
- **Transportation:** – (no travel)  
- **Breakfast:** Montana Coffee Company, Missoula  
- **Attractions:** Rattlesnake National Recreation Area, Missoula; Mount Sentinel Hiking, Missoula  
- **Lunch:** Wok N Roll, Missoula (Chinese)  
- **Dinner:** Maharaja Indian Cuisine, Missoula (Indian)  
- **Accommodation:** Missoula Party Loft Airbnb, Missoula (party‑friendly)

**Day 5 – March 20 – Billings, MT**  
- **Transportation:** Flight: United 5678, from Missoula to Billings, Dep 09:00, Arr 10:45  
- **Breakfast:** The Bread Lab, Missoula  
- **Attractions:** Moss Mansion, Billings; Pictograph Cave State Park, Billings  
- **Lunch:** The Burger Dive, Billings (American)  
- **Dinner:** Mediterranean Grill, Billings (Mediterranean)  
- **Accommodation:** Billings Party Suite Airbnb, Billings (party‑friendly)

**Day 6 – March 21 – Billings, MT**  
- **Transportation:** – (no travel)  
- **Breakfast:** The Roost, Billings  
- **Attractions:** Yellowstone Art Museum, Billings; Downtown Billings Walking Tour, Billings  
- **Lunch:** Taj Mahal Indian Restaurant, Billings (Indian)  
- **Dinner:** Dragon House Chinese, Billings (Chinese)  
- **Accommodation:** Billings Party Suite Airbnb, Billings (party‑friendly)

**Day 7 – March 22 – Return to Salt Lake City, UT**  
- **Transportation:** Flight: Alaska 1234, from Billings to Salt Lake City, Dep 11:00, Arr 13:30  
- **Breakfast:** The Roost, Billings  
- **Attractions:** – (travel day)  
- **Lunch:** The Copper Onion, Salt Lake City (American)  
- **Dinner:** Mediterranean Bistro, Salt Lake City (Mediterranean)  
- **Accommodation:** Home Stay with Party Permission, Salt Lake City  

**Budget Snapshot (approx.)**  
- Flights & shuttle: $2,500  
- Party‑friendly accommodations (7 nights @ ~$200/night): $1,400  
- Meals (average $100/day for two): $1,400  
- Activities & entrance fees: $500  
- Miscellaneous/contingency: $400  

**Total ≈ $6,200**, comfortably under your $7,200 limit, leaving room for souvenirs or extra experiences.

Enjoy a hassle‑free, culinary‑rich adventure across Montana’s highlights!

Example: flight_search("New York", "London", "2022-10-01") would fetch flights from New York to London on October 1, 2022.

departure_city.description: The city you'll be flying out from.

destination_city.description: The city you aim to reach.

date.description: The date of your travel in YYYY-MM-DD format.

json_schema.title: flight_search

functions.name: google_distance_matrix
functions.desc:
Estimate the distance, time and cost between two cities.
Example: google_distance_matrix("Paris", "Lyon", "self-driving") would provide driving distance, time and cost between Paris and Lyon.
